title: Paid order stays pending after webhook returns 200
description: When a customer orders 3 × Widget ($19.99 each), the POST /orders/:id/pay webhook returns HTTP 200, but the order status remains 'pending' instead of 'paid'. This happens only for certain price/quantity combinations. Simple totals like $25.00 work fine. The payment webhook logs show 'Payment processing error: Payment amount 59.97 does not match order total 59.970000000000006' but the response is still 200.
expectedBehavior: After POST /orders/:id/pay returns 200 with the correct amount (59.97), the order status should be 'paid' when retrieved via GET /orders/:id.
actualBehavior: POST /orders/:id/pay returns 200 with { status: 'received' } but the order status is still 'pending' on subsequent GET /orders/:id.
